displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *CVC96 or *MVC96 two-stage furnace covered by IOG-2015L, including Amana AMVC96 and ACVC96: EE9. High stage does not run; low stage can still operate. The induced draft blower is running
meaning: High stage pressure switch circuit is not closed.
causes: Pressure switch hose blocked, pinched, or needing repair
Blocked flue and/or inlet air piping, or wrong length, elbows or termination
diySteps: Look at the outdoor flue and inlet terminations for a blockage. Low stage may still heat the house
Technician: inspect the pressure switch hose, flue and inlet piping, the drain, induced draft blower performance and the wiring
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if high stage never comes on and EE9 remains after the outdoor pipes are clear.
sourceTitle: Amana and Goodman *CVC96 / *MVC96 two-stage furnace installation instructions (IOG-2015L)
